sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless game-environment material source
Input images: Image 1 is a style and palette reference only, not an edit target and not a layout reference.
Primary request: create one continuous, high-detail, seamless-looking surface texture for the worn gray limestone and dark cobblestone circulation surfaces of this isometric mountain city.
Style/medium: hand-painted high-fidelity 2D game texture matching Image 1's restrained dark fantasy realism, crisp material grain, fine cracks, irregular fitted stone, subtle age, sparse tiny moss in joints.
Composition/framing: straight orthographic material swatch filling the entire canvas; uniform texture density; no horizon, no camera perspective, no central focal point.
Lighting/mood: neutral diffuse overcast illumination with very low directional shadow so it can be relit and composited.
Color palette: charcoal gray, weathered warm gray, muted olive traces; match Image 1 without copying its scene.
Constraints: material texture only; no roads or road edges; no stairs; no buildings; no walls; no rivers; no water; no vegetation clumps; no props; no people; no text; no logos; no watermark; no frame, border, grid, panels, or separated samples.
Avoid: scene composition, recognizable architecture, large unique marks, baked cast shadows, glossy modern paving, photorealistic photography.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless game-environment material source
Input images: Image 1 is a style and palette reference only, not an edit target and not a layout reference.
Primary request: create one continuous high-detail surface texture of rugged mountain-river bank material: small slate and granite rocks, dark wet stone, compact gravel, thin restrained olive moss, sparse brown roots, and subtle water-darkened mineral staining.
Style/medium: hand-painted high-fidelity 2D game texture matching Image 1's dark fantasy realism and material sharpness.
Composition/framing: straight orthographic material swatch filling the canvas; uniform texture density; no shoreline shape, no river channel, no horizon, no camera perspective, no focal point.
Lighting/mood: neutral diffuse overcast illumination, minimal directional shadow, readable microtexture.
Color palette: charcoal slate, muted warm gray, deep wet green, restrained olive moss, very small earthy brown accents.
Constraints: material texture only; no water surface; no river edge; no bank silhouette; no roads; no paving patterns; no buildings; no stairs; no bridges; no props; no people; no text; no logos; no watermark; no frame, border, grid, panels, or separated samples.
Avoid: scene composition, large boulders, large plants, waterfalls, foam, glossy plastic wetness, photographic macro depth of field, unique recognizable marks.
